name: Brain Teasers
description: Short puzzles to think about at your own pace, with an optional hint and a revealed answer. Install a teaser pack to fill it.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Short brain teasers, one at a time, with an optional hint. The teasers come from a teaser pack.
help.goal: Nothing to win. Think it over, peek at the hint if you like, then reveal the answer.
howToPlay: Read the teaser and think about it for as long as you like.
Press Hint for a nudge, if the teaser has one.
Press Reveal answer to see the answer and why.
Optionally mark I got it or Not this time; this stays private.

controls.action: Previous or next teaser, when the card is focused
Reach Hint, Reveal answer and Next

tips: You never need to type an answer.
Your place is saved, so a break can be as short as one teaser.
